headline: Asper.ai Acquires Pricing One to Expand Agentic AI Platform
summary: Asper.ai has acquired Pricing One's Revenue Growth Management (RGM) assets and expertise. The move aims to integrate agentic AI capabilities with commercial execution plans to help CPG companies improve profitability.
why: M&A activity in the AI and software space highlights the ongoing trend of integrating specialized data analytics into corporate operational platforms.

impacts.why: The company is expanding its capabilities through acquisition.
